main.description: Take a comment away. Its author may, and an owner of its context. A comment that has been answered is emptied and stays, since the answers hang on it: its text, its author, its picture and the reactions to it go, and it reads as deleted. Any other goes to the context's bin, from which `restoreComment` brings it back.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such comment that the caller may delete, or one already emptied or in the bin.
